title: Quasi-coherent algebras on affine opens U ⊆ U': base change and the open immersion Spec A(U) → Spec A(U')
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal A$ a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_S$-algebras whose underlying $\mathcal O_S$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. For an affine open $U\subseteq S$ identify $U=\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_S(U)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U)\to U$ be induced by the structure map $\mathcal O_S(U)\to\mathcal A(U)$. Let $U\subseteq U'\subseteq S$ be affine opens, $R=\mathcal O_S(U)$, $R'=\mathcal O_S(U')$, $A=\mathcal A(U)$, $A'=\mathcal A(U')$. Then (i) the ring map $A'\otimes_{R'}R\to A$, $a'\otimes r\mapsto r\cdot a'|_U$, is an isomorphism; (ii) consequently the commutative square formed by $\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A')$ (induced by the restriction $A'\to A$), the structure morphisms, and the inclusion $U\hookrightarrow U'$ is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]; in particular $\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A')$ is an open immersion identifying $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, over $U$, with the preimage of $U$ in $\operatorname{Spec}(A')$; (iii) for affine opens $U\subseteq U'\subseteq U''$ the composition $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U)\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U')\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U'')$ is the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U)\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal A(U'')$ of (ii), and for $U=U'$ the morphism is the identity.
